0.body: Creator subscription system and crowdfunding escrow with NCX token payments on Kaia Network .

1.body: Subscription Contract - Creator subscriptions with BASIC/PREMIUM/VIP tiers CrowdfundingEscrow Contract - Challenge funding with reward tiers NCXConverter Module - Shared NCX → USDT conversion via KlaySwap Nocenix Token - Native ERC20 token with mint/burn functionality
1.title: Contracts

14.body:
Create a new crowdfunding challenge with reward tiers function createChallenge( uint256 goalAmount, uint256 durationDays, uint256[] calldata tierMinAmounts, string[] calldata tierDescriptions, uint256[] calldata tierMaxBackers
) external returns (uint256); Parameters Name Type Description goalAmount uint256 Target NCX amount to raise durationDays uint256 Challenge duration in days tierMinAmounts uint256[] Minimum NCX for each tier tierDescriptions string[] Reward descriptions for each tier tierMaxBackers uint256[] Maximum backers for each tier
14.title: createChallenge

15.body: Contribute NCX to a challenge and optionally select a reward tier function contribute(uint256 challengeId, uint256 amount, uint256 tierIndex) external nonReentrant; Parameters Name Type Description challengeId uint256 Challenge to back amount uint256 NCX amount to contribute tierIndex uint256 Reward tier (0 = no tier, 1+ = tier index)
15.title: contribute

16.body: Creator marks challenge as completed (requires goal reached) function completeChallenge(uint256 challengeId) external; Parameters Name Type Description challengeId uint256 Challenge to mark as completed
16.title: completeChallenge

17.body: Creator claims raised funds (NCX or converted to USDT) function claimFunds(uint256 challengeId, bool convertToUSDT, uint256 minUSDTOut) external nonReentrant; Parameters Name Type Description challengeId uint256 Challenge to claim from convertToUSDT bool Whether to convert NCX to USDT minUSDTOut uint256 Minimum USDT if converting (slippage protection)
17.title: claimFunds

18.body: Claim refund if challenge failed (goal not reached by deadline) function claimRefund(uint256 challengeId) external nonReentrant; Parameters Name Type Description challengeId uint256 Challenge to claim refund from
18.title: claimRefund

19.body: Get the number of reward tiers for a challenge function getTierCount(uint256 challengeId) external view returns (uint256); Parameters Name Type Description challengeId uint256 Challenge to query Returns Name Type Description <none> uint256 Number of reward tiers
19.title: getTierCount

20.body: Get details of a specific reward tier function getTier(uint256 challengeId, uint256 tierIndex) external view returns (uint256 minContribution, string memory description, uint256 maxBackers, uint256 currentBackers); Parameters Name Type Description challengeId uint256 Challenge to query tierIndex uint256 Index of the tier (0-based) Returns Name Type Description minContribution uint256 Minimum NCX required for this tier description string Reward description maxBackers uint256 Maximum number of backers allowed currentBackers uint256 Current number of backers in this tier
20.title: getTier
